source: NLM OpenI Indiana API; MeSH major+minor report labels
limitations: Small quota-sampled prototype cohort; not population representative.
Report UID is not a verified longitudinal patient ID.
Absent MeSH label treated as weak negative; labels not image-level clinical ground truth.
Frontal/lateral projections mixed; no PA-only claim.
Separate task; may overlap prior binary external cohort, not new independent binary evidence.
distribution: OpenI images, image-derived error visualizations and trained weights remain local only; excluded from Git and ZIP per project requirements.
